question: Who was re-appointed as the Solicitor General of India for a term of three years starting from 1 July 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tushar Mehta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tushar Mehta** has been re-appointed as the Solicitor General of India for a term of three years starting from 1 July 2023.
 
• The Solicitor General of India is the second-highest law officer in the country, assisting the Attorney General of India.
 
• The appointment is made by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet.
 
• Tushar Mehta has been serving in this role since October 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Solicitor General of India is responsible for advising the government on legal matters and representing the government in the Supreme Court and other courts.
 
• The position is crucial for the government's legal strategy and handling high-profile cases.
 
• Tushar Mehta has a distinguished career in law and has represented the government in several landmark cases.
 
• The re-appointment ensures continuity and stability in the legal representation of the government.
 
• The role of the Solicitor General is pivotal in upholding the rule of law and ensuring justice in the country.
